phases.name: Foundation (Weeks 1-10)

systems.note: Start here. Mechanisms of disease underpin everything.
FA pp.33-94. Heaviest section. Pair with Pixorize for metabolic pathways.
FA pp.95-122. Pair with Pixorize for immunodeficiencies.
FA pp.123-204. Largest section. Sketchy Micro is non-negotiable here.
FA pp.251-268. Ethics + Biostats. Randy Neil for biostats.

phases.ankiMode: 50-80 new cards/day from Sketchy + current system tags
phases.breakDays: Every 7th day is a mandatory break or light review day

phases.name: Organ Systems (Weeks 11-18)
phases.uworldMode: Transition to random timed blocks by week 14. Target 40-60 questions/day.
phases.ankiMode: Focus on UWorld incorrect cards. Reduce new adds.

phases.name: Assessment & Remediation (Weeks 19-24)
phases.focus: NBMEs weekly. UWorld second pass (incorrects + flagged). Targeted system remediation based on NBME analysis. Mehlman PDFs. Ethics + Biostats deep dive.
phases.uworldMode: Random timed + incorrects second pass. 60-80 questions/day.
phases.ankiMode: Reviews only in final 2 weeks. No new cards.
phases.nbmeSchedule: One NBME every 7-10 days. Forms 25-31. Newer forms last.

phases.name: Final Week (Weeks 25-26)
phases.focus: Free 120 (take at Prometric if possible). Re-watch Pathoma 1-3. Rapid Review (FA pp.670-688). Mehlman HY Arrows. Brain dump sheet practice. Sleep schedule alignment.
phases.uworldMode: Light review of flagged only. No new blocks.
phases.ankiMode: Mature card reviews only. Suspend low-yield tags.

systemCheckpoints.description: Every 4th study day within a system should be a review/checkpoint day (as per Marathoprint plan structure)
checkpointTasks: Review weak FA pages from this system
Finish any pending UWorld questions for this system
If Anki reviews for this system are piling up, clear them today
